description:
We would like to welcome you to visit us at InnoTrans, the International Trade Fair for Transport Technology.

OpenRail will be present with a booth. Our Board and Team members are looking forward to exchanging about Open Source in the railway sector, learning about your use-cases, and explaining how OpenRail can help you.

Please find more details on our participation and the schedule on our website.

summary: OpenRail Community Meetup: NightVision – Night Train Timetable Discrepancy Management
description:
Welcome to the OpenRail Community Meetup! This event series takes place every second Thursday of the month.

In this session, we are talking about NightVision. We will learn how NightVision helps identify and manage timetable discrepancies for international night trains, improving consistency and supporting seamless cross-border travel.

We welcome everyone to join the meetup, no matter the involvement in OpenRail or area and level of expertise.

summary: OpenRail Meetup: Planning the Largest Rail Freight Retrofit with Open Source
description:
Welcome to the OpenRail Community Meetup! This event series takes place every second Thursday of the month.

In this session, we are talking about PopUpSim. It is an Open Source simulation tool helping the rail sector plan the migration of 500,000+ freight wagons to the Digital Automatic Coupler (DAC), modelling pop-up workshop operations wagon by wagon to turn guesswork into evidence-based decisions. Born out of a cross-company hackathon with DB, ÖBB and SBB, it’s now open on GitHub under Apache 2.0. Come join us as a contributor, user, or just to explore the code.

We welcome everyone to join the meetup, no matter the involvement in OpenRail or area and level of expertise.
